entry.title: Planned depreciation not calculated/recorded when periodic share is less than € 0.01
entry.content:
Dear SAP,

We have a problem with some assets with very low residual book value, they are not receiving the ordinary depreciation allowance, even if their useful life has not yet expired. The problem concerns:
useful-life depreciated assets (e.g. WEET depreciation key);
percentage-amortized assets (e.g. WE3B amortization key).
Due to the very low value, the depreciation share of the period is less than € 0.01.

For this reason, the system does not calculate or record any amount.

As a result, the tuft remains with a residual value that does not reach zero by the end of the planned useful life.
We have verified the OAYO transaction and it solves the cent case but it also incorrectly rounds the values of tufts not in scope
Are there any SAP notes or standard fixes applicable to our release (S4/HANA) to handle this case?

thanks

best regards

Giuseppe

entry.title: CWIP Settlement against Final Asset created previous financial year
entry.content:
We have a list of Main Asset Created in previous financial year, however, while settling CWIP asset, the system is conisidering Asset Value date instead of Ordinary Depreciation Date which is fallen last financial year, to calculate depreciation.

Therefore, there is a mismatch of the amount of Depreciation posted in the system.

We are now looking for a solution considering this scenarios. below are the details contain the actual business scenarios:

  1. Asset Acquisition Date: 24-Feb-2026
  2. Ordinary Depreciation Start Date: 24-Feb-2026
  3. CWIP settlement / Asset Value Date: 30-Sep-2026
  4. Current result: depreciation effectively starts from 30-Sep-2026, resulting in only 1 day depreciation through period 06/2026.
  5. Expected business result: the February 2026 depreciation commencement should be respected when the CWIP amount is settled in September 2026.
